title: Open Play
description: Simple view of forward passing, shots, pass connections, and top player profiles for both teams.

team.name: Jönköpings Södra
storylines: Jönköpings Södra produced 449 progressive passes and 334 progressive carries in the sampled window.
Open play generated 161 shots, 16 goals, and 19.27 xG.
Opponents generated 124 shots, 11 goals, and 12.65 xG against in the same sample.
The clearest passing relationship is H. Lyck to S. Crona with 19 completed passes.
The radar plot highlights A. Eriksson as the strongest all-round open-play profile in this sample.
The published report includes the selected analysis match count and season scope so the frontend can keep the match slider in sync with the exposed data window.
